read.thesis: Q3 CY26 record flows: $205bn net inflows (11% annualised organic base fee growth) and as-adjusted operating margin 47.8%, but results are fee/market-driven with no capacity or supply-side content; earnings lifted by nonoperating gains.

triggers.label: Net inflows $205bn in quarter
triggers.quote: $205 billion of net inflows and 11% annualized organic base fee growth in the quarter

triggers.label: Securities lending spreads higher
triggers.quote: Securities lending revenue of $253 million increased from $203 million in the third quarter of 2025, primarily reflecting higher spreads and higher average balances

red_flags.label: GAAP EPS flattered by contingent consideration swing and nonoperating gains
red_flags.quote: also reflects higher nonoperating income in the current quarter
